description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment record with the order it serves: the order with its id, each order line with its item code, description and quantity, the total weight it should ship at, the service level the buyer ordered (economy, ground, expedited, two-day, overnight or same-day) and where it ships from and to, each with its locality, postal code and country; and the shipment with its id, the carrier, the service level booked as recorded, each line on the shipment record with its item code and quantity, each package with its id, weight and dimensions, the total weight recorded on the booking, its origin and destination and the day it was booked. The signed report gives the order, the shipment, every order line with the quantity shipped and its status as matched, short, over, missing, not ordered or unconfirmed, the quantity differences, the recorded weight or the packages’ weights summed against the order’s weight and the booking’s own total with the share apart and the 10% tolerance, the service level booked against the level ordered, and the origin and destination on each side with the postal code, country and locality matches, and counts them, and names a mismatched shipment: an order line missing from the shipment, a shipment line the order does not hold, a destination with another postal code or country, and a service level booked below the one ordered; then lines shipped short or over, another origin, another destination locality under one postal code, a weight past the tolerance and a booking total that disagrees with its packages, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No order lines, no shipment lines, quantities missing on a matched line, a destination or service level not stated on both sides, or an order weight with none recorded on the shipment leaves the shipment unverified. This reads one shipment record against the order it serves: a shipping promise against its delivery evidence is wever_shipping-check, an invoice’s lines and shipping charge against its job is wever_invoice-check and delivered work against its acceptance criteria is wever_deliverable-check. Verdict logistics_shipment_mismatched, logistics_shipment_partial, logistics_shipment_unverified or logistics_shipment_matching. POST /api/logistics-shipment-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.
